_comment: The anchor of the whole menu. If only one place ever worked, it should be this one: a Schrebergarten in late August is the exact register the product is aiming at -- warm, ordinary, nothing happening, and gone. It is also the easiest scene for a model to get right, which makes it the sensible first thing to point at a new provider.
label: Allotment garden, late August

prompt._comment: Named props beat adjectives. 'A glass bottle of mineral water with a foil label' places the decade on its own; 'nostalgic summer atmosphere' places nothing and costs a generation to find that out.
prompt.scene: a small German allotment garden behind a clipped privet hedge, a folding table with a patterned plastic tablecloth, four white plastic chairs, a watering can and a coiled green hose beside a wooden shed
prompt.light: low late-August sun coming through the hedge from the left, long shadows across uneven grass, warm and completely ordinary
prompt.lens: a consumer zoom near its wide end, deep focus from the table all the way to the shed, a little barrel bend at the edges
prompt.framing: waist-up, three-quarters to the camera, standing at the end of the table with the shed behind
prompt.eraProps: a glass bottle of mineral water with a foil label, a green hose reel, a bicycle with a dynamo leaning on the fence, a tin watering can

motionHint: the hedge and the tablecloth move a little in the breeze, and a wasp turns slowly around the bottle

lookOverride._comment: Warm, bright, open air: the base grain is already right, so this only pushes the amber a little and opens the halation on the low sun through the hedge.
